segments.text:
V. 36.
Say ye of him whom the Father hath ſanctified, and ſent into the world—This Sanctification (whereby He is eſſentially, The Holy One of GOD) is mentioned as prior to his Miſſion, and together with it implies, Chriſt was GOD in the higheſt Senſe, infinitely ſuperior to that wherein thoſe Judges were ſo called.
